name: Fairest Wheels
description: A chilled, rolled tortilla snack filled with a spicy chicken and cheese mixture.
recipeIngredient: ⅔ cup chopped green bell pepper
⅓ cup minced green onions and red pepper

recipeInstructions.text: In a medium bowl, combine chicken, lettuce, cheddar cheese.
In another bowl, beat cream cheese and sour cream together until smooth.
Add the cream cheese mixture to the chicken mixture and mix well.
Spread ⅓ cup of the chicken and cream cheese mixture onto one side of a tortilla, leaving a ½-inch border at the top.
Sprinkle with ⅓ cup shredded cheese and top with red pepper jelly.
Roll up the tortilla tightly and seal the edge.
Repeat with remaining tortillas and filling mixture.
Wrap each roll in plastic wrap and refrigerate for 2 hours.
Trim the ends off each roll and cut into 8 slices.
Serve cold.

keywords: chicken roll-ups, cheese snack, cold appetizer

_similar.name: Macaroni Salad
_similar.description: A classic macaroni salad with tuna, ham, and cheddar cheese, mixed with Miracle Whip and spices.

recipeInstructions.text: Cook macaroni according to package directions. Let cool.
Cut up celery, cheese, tuna, and ham into small pieces.
Combine cooled macaroni with the tuna mixture.
Add enough Miracle Whip to moisten the salad.
Sprinkle with parsley flakes and paprika.
Mix well and serve.

_similar.keywords: macaroni salad, tuna salad, cheddar cheese

_similar.name: Veggie Pizza
_similar.description: A simple and customizable veggie pizza using crescent rolls as the crust, topped with a cream cheese mixture and various vegetables.
recipeIngredient: Veggies (broccoli, cauliflower, carrots, celery, red or green peppers, green onions)

recipeInstructions.text: Roll out crescent rolls on a cookie sheet and a small cake pan. Bake until golden brown. Cool.
Mix sour cream, mayonnaise, cream cheese, and ranch dressing to make the cream mixture.
Spread cream mixture on cooled rolls.
Top with finely chopped vegetables of your choice.
Cover with grated cheddar cheese.
Chill and cut into small pieces. Serve as hors d'oeuvres.

_similar.name: Veggie Pizza
_similar.description: A simple veggie pizza made with a crescent roll crust, cream cheese, ranch dressing, and various chopped vegetables.
recipeIngredient: 1/2 cup finely chopped green or red pepper

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 375°F.
Roll out crescent roll dough on a flat cookie sheet.
Bake until golden brown.
Mix cream cheese with ranch dressing.
Spread the cream cheese mixture onto the cooled crust.
Top with chopped vegetables.
Keep refrigerated before serving.
Cut with pizza cutter or knife.

_similar.keywords: veggie pizza, crescent roll crust, cream cheese, ranch dressing

_similar.name: Cornbread Salad
_similar.description: A layered salad with crumbled cornbread, black beans, corn, cheese, and a creamy dressing, perfect for chilling before serving.
recipeIngredient: 1 (11 oz) can whole kernel corn, drained
1 (15 oz) can black beans, rinsed and drained
½ cup salad dressing or mayonnaise
½ cup chopped fresh cilantro or parsley
6 plum or tiny tim tomatoes, shredded

recipeInstructions.text: Prepare cornbread mix according to package directions and let cool. Crumble into pieces.
In a food processor or blender, combine salad dressing (or mayonnaise), lime juice, cumin, and salt. Process until smooth.
Layer half of the lettuce, cornbread, dressing mixture, beans, corn, cheese, red bell pepper, green onions, and tomatoes in a 4-quart bowl.
Repeat the layers, finishing with the remaining dressing on top. Garnish as desired with cilantro or onion curls.
Cover and chill for 1 to 2 hours before serving.

_similar.keywords: Cornbread salad, layered salad, Southwestern salad

_similar.name: Layered Coleslaw Salad
